title: MCHeli throwable
description: A YAML file in assets/mcheli/throwable/ of an MCHeli addon pack. Generated from the game's schema declarations; do not edit.

Author.description: A name, or a list of names.

DisplayName.description: The name, or a map of language codes (en_us, ja_jp) to names where DEFAULT is the name itself. Legacy TXT key: displayname.

ItemID.description: Numeric item ids only matter for very old packs. Legacy TXT key: itemid.

StackSize.description: The game clamps a value outside 1 to 64 and says so. Legacy TXT key: stacksize.

Volume.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: soundvolume.

Pitch.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1 and says so. Legacy TXT key: soundpitch.

Power.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 2147483647 and says so. Legacy TXT key: power.

Acceleration.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: acceleration.

AccelerationInWater.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: accelerationinwater.

DispenseAcceleration.description: Throwing speed when a dispenser throws it. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: dispenseacceleration.

Explosion.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: explosion.

DelayFuse.description: Ticks between the first impact and the explosion. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: delayfuse.

Bound.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bound.

TimeFuse.description: Ticks from the throw to the explosion; 0 waits for an impact. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: timefuse.

ProximityFuseDist.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 20 and says so. Legacy TXT key: proximityfusedist.

Accuracy.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: accuracy.

AliveTime.description: Ticks the grenade (or its smoke) exists. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: alivetime.

Bomblet.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bomblet.

BombletSpread.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: bombletdiff.

Gravity.description: The game clamps a value outside -50 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: gravity.

GravityInWater.description: The game clamps a value outside -50 to 50 and says so. Legacy TXT key: gravityinwater.

Size.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokesize.

Count.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokenum.

Color.description: TXT 'SmokeColor = r, g, b' (0 to 255, always opaque); see smokeColorLine. A colour: hex '#AARRGGBB' or '#RRGGBB', or a list [a, r, g, b] of numbers from 0 to 1.

Vertical.description: The game clamps a value outside -100 to 100 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokevelocityvertical.

Horizontal.description: The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: smokevelocityhorizontal.

Particle.description: No longer supported: the game ignores this key and says so once per load. You can delete it.

SchemaVersion.description: The content schema version the file is written for. Optional; a file without it is version 1. This game reads version 1.
